# What does a dental really cost your clinic at grade 4?

> Free calculator for veterinary clinics: itemised dental estimate and clinic profit for each grade of dental disease, profit per anesthesia hour, the price that hits your margin and what a flat dental quote loses. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/veterinary-dental-estimate-calculator/)
